Hon'ble Smt. Justice Rajani Dubey Order on Board 14.06.2024
1.

The applicant has preferred this Second bail application, under Section 439 of the Criminal Procedure Code for grant of regular bail as he is arrested in connection with Crime No. 42/2022,
registered at Police Station- Bhanupratappur, District- North Bastar Kanker (C.G.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 324, 342 & 323 of Indian Penal Code.
2.
Learned counsel for the applicant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the bail application.
He, however, prays for direction to the trial Court to conclude the trial as early as possible.
